    Is it free?

    Yes. Both days are completely free to attend.

    Is it live?

    Studio-produced sessions are played live, followed by live Q&A with speakers. Expect live polls and challenges.

    CHROs, HR heads, managers, specialists and early-career HR.

    Will I get a certificate?

    Yes, attendees will receive a certificate.

    How do points work?

    Register: 100. HRD Ministry vote: 50. Each peer who registers with your link: 100. Submit a confession: 25, once per email. Top 10 win prizes.

    Where do I join on the day?

    Your joining link will be sent by email and WhatsApp before the summit.
